receipt.reason: Independent review of PR #1009 found that the Python oracle silently falls back to a different Runtime when an explicitly requested --binary is missing or not executable. Keep the Rust CLI's safer identity-bound fail-closed choice, document this one deliberate compatibility difference, and add real-process negative tests. Preserve the 28/28 receipt for the previous snapshot without treating it as acceptance of the amended Contract.
